description: Write a Romanian e-Factura invoice (UBL 2.1, CIUS-RO) from fields: seller and buyer, lines with their net price, quantity and VAT category, the currency, the payment terms. Totals are computed exactly (each line rounded to 2 decimals, VAT once per category and rate), and the draft is checked first: CIF, CNP and IBAN check digits, the county and Bucharest sector, the VAT rules per category, CIUS-RO's lengths, every problem named at once. The file goes to the outbox; the answer gives its path, sha256 and totals. Nothing is sent to ANAF: next, validate_invoice with xml: { path }, then upload_invoice with the same path to file it. An invoice in another currency needs vat_exchange_rate (RON per unit), so its VAT is stated in RON too.

city.description: In Bucharest, the sector: "Sector 3" is written SECTOR3.

county.description: For a Romanian address, required: the county code, CJ or RO-CJ; B for Bucharest.

company_id.description: A buyer that is not a VAT payer: its CUI (checked); a person: the CNP, or 0000000000000 when not given.

vat_id.description: The VAT id: RO and the CIF for a Romanian VAT payer (checked by its control digit), or a foreign VAT id.

due_date.description: When payment is due; an amount due needs this or payment terms.

file_name.description: The file's name in the outbox; by default the invoice number's.

price.description: The NET price per unit, in the invoice's currency.

quantity.description: Negative on a line that reverses an earlier invoice.

unit_code.description: UN/ECE Rec. 20: H87 piece (default), C62 one, HUR hour, DAY, MON month, KGM kilogram.

vat_category.description: S standard (default), Z zero rated, E exempt, AE reverse charge, G export outside the EU, O outside the scope of VAT.

vat_percent.description: The VAT rate for S (21, 11); 0 for every other category.

number.description: The invoice number, series included; it must contain a digit.

iban.description: The account to pay into, checked by its check digits.

means_code.description: UNTDID 4461: 30 credit transfer (the default with an iban), 42 to a bank account, 10 cash, 48 card.

preceding_invoice.description: The invoice this one corrects or reverses.

save_dir.description: A folder INSIDE the outbox (e.g. "2026-10"); empty means the outbox itself.

city.description: In Bucharest, the sector: "Sector 3" is written SECTOR3.

county.description: For a Romanian address, required: the county code, CJ or RO-CJ; B for Bucharest.

company_id.description: The trade register number (J99/1234/2020) or EUID.

legal_form.description: Share capital and the like, e.g. "Capital social 200 RON".

vat_id.description: The VAT id: RO and the CIF for a Romanian VAT payer (checked by its control digit), or a foreign VAT id.

vat_exchange_rate.description: For an invoice not in RON, required: RON for one unit of its currency (bnr's rate); the VAT is then also stated in RON.

vat_exemptions.description: Why a category carries no VAT: required for E (a VATEX-EU code or the law's words); AE, G and O default to VATEX-EU-AE, -G, -O.

name: build_invoice

extern.description: The buyer is not Romanian: upload it with extern: true

invoice.description: The file read back the way upload_invoice reads it for its confirmation line

path.description: The built file in the outbox: give it to validate_invoice and upload_invoice as xml: { path }

title: Build a CIUS-RO invoice
